name: Paid-Cash
author: PAID-CASH

sections.description:
The Paid-Cash Payments for WooCommerce plugin allows payment of items on a woocommerce site using the Paid-Cash payment system.

Key features:
* Seamless WooCommerce integration
* QR Code generation for mobile payments
* Real-time account number validation
* Marketplace code support
* Intuitive tabbed user interface
* Multilingual support

Configuration

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  2. Enable the “Paid-Cash Mobile Payments” payment method
  3. Configure settings:
    • Title and description displayed at checkout
    • Paid-Cash server URL
    • API key
    • Merchant Paid-Cash account number

Markdown Example

The plugin offers:

  1. Seamless WooCommerce integration
  2. Simplified payment process
  3. Enhanced security

Key features:

  • QR Code payments
  • Real-time validation
  • Intuitive interface
  • Technical support

For more information, visit Paid-Cash website.

“The simplest mobile payment solution in Africa”
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the ZIP file
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Configure settings in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
sections.faq:
How do I get Paid-Cash credentials?

You need to register on the Paid-Cash platform to obtain:
– Your Paid-Cash account number
– Your API key
– The server URL to use

Does the plugin work with virtual products?

No, the plugin supports both physical products.

How can I test payments?

Use the test account provided by Paid-Cash to perform test transactions before going live.
